name: uacos-public-multi-repo-benchmark
description: Repeatable public multi-repository benchmark pilot using UACOS plus two independent public repositories. This is evidence of multi-repo operation, not evidence for the private target-repository benchmark set.
method_notes: This profile runs against public repositories checked out at exact commits by GitHub Actions.
The benchmark demonstrates multi-repository context selection and compression behavior across three repositories.
It does not replace the pending benchmark against Bear Detector, RTSP Recorder, SuperConnect, and EMSTONE/VMS Integration.
99% may only describe full-repo input-context reduction on measured tasks, not total AI workflow token savings.
